The involvement of Cyp2e1, a cytochrome P450 enzyme, suggests that Trimethadione could indirectly modulate Cyp2e1 activity through the regulation of Cyp2c19. This mechanism highlights a potential role for Trimethadione in modulating metabolic processes by targeting and influencing the activity of Cyp2c19, which in turn may affect Cyp2e1.
